ValidationRule.description: This rule describes that the user should not be able to change "At Risk Assessment Requested” flag once it is checked .
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Owner_Manager__c )), NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Manager_of_Manager_OwnerId__c )), $RecordType.Name = "IME SC Case" , ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Customer_At_Risk__c ) , NOT (IME_SC_Customer_At_Risk__c ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: At Risk Assessment Requested cannot be unchecked.
